content.title: Event Details - TCS New York City Marathon
content.text: Skip to content Facebook Twitter Instagram About 2026 TCS NYC Marathon The TCS New York City Marathon, the world’s largest marathon, is always held on the first Sunday in November and runs through all five boroughs, from Staten Island to Central Park. Run since 1970, the marathon is one of the Abbott World Marathon Majors. About Liver Life Challenge Liver Life Challenge is the American Liver Foundation’s (ALF) official endurance program, where dedicated athletes from across the country use their passion and commitment to go the extra mile for the liver community.Funds raised through Liver Life Challenge benefit the 100 million Americans affected by liver disease through resources, education and support services and help advance our advocacy efforts on Capitol Hill and liver disease research.ALF is an official charity partner at several prestigious races throughout the country. Click to view other Liver Life Challenge events and apply to become one of the thousands who have already joined in the race towards a world without liver disease. Event Details When: November 1, 2026 Where: New York City Age Minimum: Open to ages 16+ Contact:Sarah Millersmiller@liverfoundation.org646-737-9414 Fundraising Commitment:Charity Runner: $5,000I Have My Own Entry: $2,000Participants are responsible for paying the registration fee to the TCS NYC Marathon in the amount that they require.
